She wrapped the note in oilcloth and began composing the telegram she had prayed she would never have to send.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市褪去了白日的喧嚣，只剩路灯孤零零地亮着。环卫工人的扫帚声在空荡的街道上回响，早点铺的蒸笼升起第一缕白汽。出租车缓缓驶过高架桥，车灯划破薄雾。写字楼里还亮着几扇窗，那是尚未下班的人。猫从墙头一跃而过，海棠花在露水中静静开放。这座城市正在浅睡中翻身，等待第一班公交碾过晨光。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something is defined using a smaller version of itself — like a story inside a story.\n• Imagine standing between two facing mirrors: you see a reflection of a reflection of a reflection, each one smaller than the last.\n• To keep it from going on forever, you always need a stopping point (a base case), like the smallest reflection that finally doesn't show another one."}
